title: How to Align Your Interests in Your Job Search
description:
In this @teal_hq class, we're gonna talk about your interests, which are the things that you want to do, and how you can build your career in a way that enables you to do those things. 

Here’s what we’ll cover: 

1. How we approach interests, and the difference between personal passions and professional passions. 
2. Some of the frameworks that we're referencing, as well as ones that we've created.
3. How to define your interests.
4. We’ll start to bring together the notion of interest and values and what matters to you, and then what the blockers might be, whether perceived or actual.

00:00 | Introduction
00:47 | The difference between personal & professionals passions 
05:35 | How to define your interests
14:46 | Bringing together the notion of interest and values and what matters to you
19:26 | What are your blockers? (whether perceived or actual)
28:05 | Wrapping up & conclusion

For more tips on creating a meaningful career, watch the rest of the videos on this playlist.
